rule: Equivalent authorized SHEIN campaign requests use the same skills, route, shared Engine v3, deterministic adapter, guards, recovery and readback regardless of requester. There is no Rodolfo-only fast lane.
manager_scope: G001-G006: each canonical assigned manager only in their own parent channel and on their own catalog-bound accounts; exact sender ID and parent channel are mandatory runtime metadata
rodolfo_scope: Authorized global SHEIN requests; same executor and validation pipeline
delivery_status: Explicit request PAUSED or ACTIVE with explicit valid schedule; never infer activation
material_input_differences: New media processing, empty accounts without approved Page/pixel/destination/copy, live account restrictions, quota and missing asset eligibility remain real prerequisites, not requester-dependent procedures.
runtime_release_gate: Claim general runtime readiness only after account bindings, mode construction, authority isolation, offline execution/recovery tests and live read-only validation have passed. Real creation timing requires a new explicitly authorized campaign request.
